pattern: ざるを得ない（ざるをえない）
purpose: Explain that circumstances force an unwanted or reluctant action.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
Vない stem + ざるを得ない; する → せざるを得ない
Heavy snow closed the roads, so we had no choice but to change our plans.
After seeing the evidence, I had to admit my mistake.
We are short-staffed and have no choice but to postpone.
formation: Vない stem + ざるを得ない; する → せざるを得ない
restrictions: Usually implies reluctance or a lack of alternatives.
mistake: する becomes せざる, not しざる.
